Spotlight: Won here (1m, good) in June on first course visit; no match for the winner when second here (1m, good to firm) next time but he returned to winning ways in commanding fashion over today's C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago; a 7lb rise takes him to a career-high mark but he has to be respected.

RaceName: Sky Bet Price Boosts Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Three 1m2f wins on Newcastle AW towards the end of last year and he returned from a break and wind surgery to finish second over C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago; he was no match for the winner Jez Bomb but is 7lb better off today and is not ruled out.

RaceName: Sky Bet Price Boosts Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 8yo who won off this mark on his stable debut at Ripon (1m, good) last month; two reasonable performances have followed (1m/1m2f, good to firm/good) but he needs something extra to come out on top today.

RaceName: Sky Bet Price Boosts Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Made all at 15-2 on debut at Redcar (1m2f, good) in June and faded into sixth of eight in warm novice at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) last month, having failed to settle; this very lightly raced 3yo could be suited by the return to 1m2f on his handicap debut and he's a possible player.

RaceName: Sky Bet Price Boosts Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: S Bulmer, P Hebdon & R Taylor
Spotlight: Won four-runner handicap at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) last month and close fourth of 15 at York (1m, good to firm) next time; caught wide early and failed to settle when mid-division in competitive handicap at Haydock (1m, good) last Saturday so that run can be forgiven; not discounted.

RaceName: Sky Bet Price Boosts Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: Two Plus Three Two Plus Four
Spotlight: Yet to pose a serious threat this season and unproven at the trip, but he kept on well for fifth in a hot race at Ascot (1m, good to firm) two starts ago, and he didn't run badly in a big-field 3yo handicap at Glorious Goodwood (1m, good to firm) last time; not ruled out in first-time visor.

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Handicap
Spotlight: Three of her four wins have come over C&D, including for second successive year last month when making much of running in beating Harry's Hill 0.5l on good-to-firm (Happy Henry fifth) under today's rider; 6lb rise but has to be respected given her record here.

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Handicap
Spotlight: Won 5f Cork maiden a year ago (good) and didn't reappear until last month, encouraging comeback run at Fairyhouse (6f) but didn't get home at Naas three weeks later over same trip; return to 5f should suit and handicapper has dropped her 4lb.

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Handicap
Spotlight: Was gaining second turf win when scoring over this trip at Naas in May off 68; safely held both starts since, latest over same C&D so needs to improve; jockey booking encouraging.

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Handicap
Spotlight: Two-time turf winner in 2024, including over C&D; good AW run last winter and fine return from over three months' absence when second at Naas last month off reduced mark (third has won since); definite player.

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Handicap
Spotlight: Nine-time winner, including twice over C&D; no joy yet this season, going closest on latest when staying on well into second late on behind 0.5l winner Mary Shoelaces over C&D last month on ground on the quick side for him; nice turn around in the weights with that rival, with rider now claiming.

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Handicap
Spotlight: In good form this summer over this trip on quick ground, winning at Navan and Bellewstown; not a bad effort after aggregate 17lb rise when under 2l off Mary Shoelaces over C&D last month, staying on after briefly short of room; respected.

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Handicap
Spotlight: Dual winner over this trip last season at Naas and Down Royal; gelded on the back of a couple of poor runs and return to 7f backfired at Fairyhouse on latest; questions to answer at this stage although handicapper quick to relent and 1lb below last winning mark now.

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced maiden showed some measure of ability on final two maiden runs last year; shaped like the run was needed when beaten 6l at Cork on Friday.

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Handicap
Spotlight: Godolphin cast-off; rated 74 after making the frame on all three starts for Charlie Appleby; now down to 56 after being tried over various trips this term; cheekpieces tried.

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Handicap
Spotlight: Got off the mark at Tipperary a year ago over this trip; hasn't added to that, short of room when last seen at Naas in late June; handicapper giving him every chance (1lb wrong).

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs Annette Coogan & J M O'Reilly & Frank Condra
Spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo finished stone last on last month's handicap debut over 1m; speedily-bred so could improve for this marked drop in trip; 2lb wrong

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Handicap
OwnerName: T J Flanagan & Ronan Macken & Shane McSweeney & S O'Malley
Spotlight: Sole success came in 6f Dundalk handicap in March off 49; has changed yards since fair turf effort at Down Royal in late May; 3lb wrong here; last of 12 at Cork on Friday on first start for this stable.

RaceName: IFAHR CUP HANDICAP STAKES 0-95
Spotlight: Made an impressive debut under this rider when winning at Lingfield last month, where he won by fourteen lengths in a weaker race than this; the extra furlong here on his handicap debut shouldn't be an issue, gives weight all round against some horses with solid form here, but he has obvious claims. (R1 W1 P0) (OR 88)

RaceName: IFAHR CUP HANDICAP STAKES 0-95
Spotlight: Was narrowly beaten into second in this race last year but has gone from strength to strength since then; has won both his starts comfortably this season the most recent in May over a furlong further than this; has changed ownership and trainers since that run, he goes well fresh and if returning in the same form holds solid claims. (R9 W2 P6) (OR 76)

RaceName: IFAHR CUP HANDICAP STAKES 0-95
Spotlight: Stout stayer, who won this race last year when he made all the running. Was pestered on the lead at Lingfield last time when behind Ash'jaa but gets a big pull in the weights here; an easy lead looks likely here so should give it a good go from off the front.  (R21 W3 P8) (OR 72)

RaceName: IFAHR CUP HANDICAP STAKES 0-95
Spotlight: Finished fifth in this race last year but was ahead of Jeewan on her only start at Bath in the Spring; she's out of the weights here but has become very well treated nowadays, so she can't be discounted getting weight all round. (R14 W1 P8) (OR 64)(15oh)

RaceName: Sky Bet Build A Bet Handicap
Spotlight: He couldn't get into it in a big field at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last Monday but he didn't enjoy an ideal passage and went there on a four-timer following three wins here (6f/5f, good/good to firm); this 9yo could play a leading role back at Pontefract.

RaceName: Sky Bet Build A Bet Handicap
Spotlight: Found a Group 3 too much at York last month but she was a very close third when back in a handicap at Hamilton (5f, good) a fortnight ago; she was denied a clear run last time and this progressive 4yo could be firmly in the mix up 2lb.

RaceName: Sky Bet Build A Bet Handicap
